parsed.explanation: Parent regime governs the visit: birth-sex passport rules with reported confiscations, entry cable requiring refusal on sex discrepancy and possible permanent fraud ineligibility, a national ban on gender-identity use of government single-sex facilities, and documented severe harm in federal/immigration custody. No presentation offence, organised street sweeps, or execution risk, and courts have enjoined several orders, hate-crime and anti-discrimination law exist nationally, and litigation is active, so recourse is partial rather than absent. This state adds mitigation: no local bathroom ban and 2013 public-accommodations and hate-crime-enhancement protections, but no documented enforcement outcomes, and it cannot override border, federal-facility, or federal-custody rules. Hence elevated risk, above the parent average but well below jurisdictions with no universal exposure.
